text:
Riley K.: Quick: drafting the internal note for the midnight EU push. Need a punchy one-liner + exact rollback bullets.
Ben T.: Call out model pin stability again. Last time a cron bumped a pin during promote.
Aisha M.: Timeline? EU night windows are sensitive to oncall overlap.
Riley K.: Start: Thu 01:00 UTC (Wed 18:00 PT). Change window 45m. Canary cadence: 10% x 15m -> 60% x 15m -> promote. Expected active change ~30m + monitoring.
Victor P.: Add the embed index refresh note: it runs post-promote and may cause short-lived similarity score drift for ~10-18m. Support should be ready with advisory.
Ben T.: Rollback criteria suggestion: 5m error rate >= 1.2% OR P95 latency increase > 450ms for 10m OR embedding reindex fail.
Riley K.: Draft blurb for review:
"Microdeploy v2.5.1 — rolling canary Thu 01:00 UTC. Fixes: runtime stability tweaks, KV cache prefetch resilience, embedding refresh orchestration. Ops will monitor thresholds and roll back to v2.5.0 on breach. Expect brief similarity search variance during index refresh."
Aisha M.: Nice. Add explicit pin note: "Do not update pinned model refs during canary. Verify pins after promote; contact infra@redwood if mismatch."
Victor P.: Include deploy snippet for ops so they can copy it into runbook:
```
/deploy canary v2.5.1 --region=eu-west-1 --steps=10,60,100 --watch --timeout=45m
/deploy rollback v2.5.1 v2.5.0 --reason="ops-threshold"
```
deploy-bot: canary request queued by Riley K. for v2.5.1. Use `/deploy status 9753102468` to follow.
Ben T.: And a short rollback checklist in the blurb for non-ops readers:
- run `/deploy rollback v2.5.1 v2.5.0`
- disable canary routing if necessary
- post status in #incident-announce
- notify support@redwood and page @sre-oncall

Aisha M.: For the internal announcement, keep it short: one-liner + three bullets (visible changes, brief user impact, rollback steps) + links to playbooks. I'll own the blast in #all-hands if approved.
Riley K.: Links to include:
- Canary playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/canary-playbook
- Pin-checks: https://wiki.redwood/internal/pinchecks/v2.5.1-dryrun
- Evac runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/evac-runbook

Victor P.: Also add a small "What to watch" list for oncall: 500 spikes, GPU memory creep, embedding-job duration > 20m, KV miss rate.
Ben T.: Can someone run the pin dry-run Tue 14:00 UTC and post the table here? If theres a mismatch, we push 24h.
Aisha M.: I'll take the dry-run Tue 14:00 UTC and paste the pin table. If green, I will post the internal draft Wed 12:00 UTC for signoff.
infra-bot: scheduled maintenance collision check: no collisions detected in target window.
ops-bot: reminder: run deploy from ops CI with `--watch` to enable automated threshold evaluation.
deploy-bot: reminder: include `--timeout` and `--watch` on canary commands to allow auto rollback.
Riley K.: Final ask: signoffs by Wed 20:00 UTC. If you have copy edits, ping me here. I'll merge the release notes and hand to Aisha for the announcement after signoff. :thumbsup:
